newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, BAT IN FIFTH TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA WIN TOSS, BAT IN FIFTH TEST.

text.p: Australia won the toss and decided to bat against England in the fifth test at Trent Bridge on Thursday.
England omitted left-arm spinner Phil Tufnell from their 12, giving test debuts to the Hollioake brothers, Adam and Ben.
Ben Hollioake, 19, became the youngest England test player since Brian Close 48 years ago.
Australia were unchanged from the fourth test at Headingley.
England - Michael Atherton (captain), Alec Stewart, John Crawley, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, Adam Hollioake, Ben Hollioake, Robert Croft, Andy Caddick, Dean Headley, Devon Malcolm.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Ricky Ponting, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Paul Reiffel, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath.
Umpires: David Shepherd (England), Cyril Mitchley (South Africa).
